lead_raw_text:
The structure of CaMg14Co crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I4/mmm (No. 143), with 16 atoms in the unit cell distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements for all centers: Ca and Co each have 12 geometric neighbors, while Mg centers show 12 neighbors with varying Ca, Mg, and Co compositions. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations indicate that 12-vertex Mg coordination polyhedra exhibit corner-, edge-, and face-sharing, and Mg–Mg polyhedra also show corner- and edge-sharing.
